claims.statement: For each favorable leaf v, Delta_p(T-v)<0 is equivalent to the mean addability of a uniform independent p-set of T-v being less than p+1; the desired v-summand is an adjacent-rank difference in the marked slice of H_v. This exact translation supplies no comparison between those measures and does not resolve the global lower-region aggregate.
claims.scope: The stated probability identity for finite ordinary trees and eligible (T,p), with the selector fixed as Delta_p(T-v)<0 and original leaf data; partial reformulation only.
claims.reason: retained: the addability double count, favorable-case denominator, marked incidence count, and summand identity check out. The source correctly identifies the absent bridge to the aggregate deficit budget; the partial reformulation proves neither that budget nor a counterexample.

limitations: No proof of the global deficit budget or complete lower-region aggregate is obtained.
No eligible ordinary-tree counterexample or independent finite census is produced.
The expectation formula is defined when i_p(T-v)>0; this condition is automatic for a favorable leaf because zero i_p forces zero i_(p+1).
